name: branding-dark-avare-brand-tiles-nav-pill-states-and-stat-tiles
title: Dark Brand Tiles with Nav Pill States
whatItIs: A dark slate bento cropped at the top: a blue gradient tile with a white wordmark and triangle mark, stat tiles (60+ Screens, 10+ Flow), a notification card with the app icon, five rows of pill navigation showing each tab active in white, and a phone on a rock ledge showing a profile screen.
whatItMeans: Showing each nav state in a row demonstrates the system, and a single blue tile anchors the dark board.
techniques: Nav bar shown five times with a moving white pill
Blue gradient logo tile as the colour anchor
Notification card as a brand touchpoint
Phone on a dark ledge for atmosphere

vocabulary.definition: A white rounded shape marking the selected tab.
A tile with a big number and a label.
A card imitating a real place the brand appears.
